The '''L04 Silent Thunder concussion missile''' was a type of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Too large for any typical [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to carry in large numbers, the Silent Thunder was designed to lock onto a target and use its onboard fuel supply to travel long distances and destroy the enemy [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Only two L04 missiles were typically required to destroy a single enemy craft.<ref name="Starfighter" />
